# Slideout Menu

A panel that slides in from the side of the screen, triggered by a button. It surfaces navigation, options, or extra content without cluttering the main view. Composed of a header (featured icon + title + description + close), a scrollable body (a menu-items list or a custom content slot), and an actions footer. Anchors left or right, ships gray or white, and mirrors fully for RTL. Modeled on Figma frames 23360:17219 (Slideout Menu) and 23521:31454 (Slideout Menu Header); the body reuses the Menu component.

**Stylesheet:** `components/slideout-menu/slideout-menu.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/slideout-menu.js` (classes `SlideoutManager`); wired through `[data-slideout-open]`, `[data-slideout-close]`, `[data-for]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

Classes and JS hooks for composing and triggering a slideout.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.slideout-backdrop` | Overlay | Dimmed full-screen overlay. Add .is-open to show. |
| `.slideout` | Panel | 346px side panel, fixed full-height, slides in via transform. .is-open reveals it. |
| `.slideout--right` | Modifier | Anchor the panel to the right edge (default is left / leading). |
| `.slideout--gray` | Modifier | Use the gray background (#F9FAFB) instead of white. |
| `.slideout--inline` | Modifier | Render the panel in normal flow (used by the docs previews) instead of fixed/sliding. |
| `.slideout__header` | Slot | Featured icon + title + description + close button. |
| `.slideout__body` | Slot | Scrollable content area. Hosts a .menu (groups/items) or a .slideout-custom slot. |
| `.slideout__footer` | Slot | Action buttons row (equal-width). |
| `data-slideout-open="ID"` | JS hook | On a trigger — opens the panel with that id over its backdrop. |
| `data-slideout-close` | JS hook | On any element inside the panel — closes it. Backdrop click and ESC also close. |

## Anatomy

Header (featured icon + title + description + close), a scrollable body — here a grouped menu list — and an actions footer.

```html
<div class="slideout slideout--inline" style="width: 346px;">
    <div class="slideout__header">
        <span class="slideout__icon"><span class="dga-icon-add-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
        <div class="slideout__heading">
            <h3 class="slideout__title">Title</h3>
            <p class="slideout__description">Description goes here.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="slideout__close" aria-label="Close"><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="slideout__body">
        <div class="menu" role="menu">
            <div class="menu-group">
                <p class="menu-group__label">Group label</p>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span></div>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span></div>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="menu-group" data-menu-select="">
                <p class="menu-group__label">Group label</p>
                <div class="menu-item menu-item--selected" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span><span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <path d="M4 10l4 4 8-8"></path>
                        </svg></span></div>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="slideout__footer">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Action</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Action</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Open as Overlay

The real behavior — a trigger slides the panel in over a dimmed backdrop. Use the left or right trigger; close via the X, the backdrop, or Esc.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" data-slideout-open="slideout-left">Open from left</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline" data-slideout-open="slideout-right">Open from right</button>
```

## RTL Support

For Arabic, the header mirrors (featured icon on the right, close on the left), the menu items read right-to-left, and the panel slides from the opposite edge.

```html
<div class="slideout slideout--inline slideout--rtl" dir="rtl" style="width: 346px;">
    <div class="slideout__header">
        <span class="slideout__icon"><span class="dga-icon-add-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
        <div class="slideout__heading">
            <h3 class="slideout__title">عنوان</h3>
            <p class="slideout__description">هنا يوضع الوصف.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="slideout__close" aria-label="إغلاق"><span class="dga-icon-cancel-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="slideout__body">
        <div class="menu" role="menu">
            <div class="menu-group" data-menu-select="">
                <p class="menu-group__label">عنوان المجموعة</p>
                <div class="menu-item menu-item--selected" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span><span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                            <path d="M4 10l4 4 8-8"></path>
                        </svg></span></div>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span></div>
                <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="slideout__footer">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">إجراء</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">إجراء</button>
    </div>
</div>
```
